notes: Primary source for every game (date, home/away, score) is the Sina Sports CBA database season schedule (cba.sports.sina.com.cn/cba/schedule/all/?qleagueid=...), which lists home team first.
ot = number of overtime periods, from Sina match pages (period-by-period line score, checked to sum to final score); periods = [[home,away],...] Q1-Q4 then OTs.
Every game was cross-checked against asia-basket.com (eurobasket) full CBA schedule pages; Wikipedia (zh/en) box scores and brackets used as further cross-checks where available.
Series teams are ordered [winner, loser]; wins likewise. best_of is the series length implied by the winning total of the stage (consistent across all series in that stage).
2019-20 (year 2020) and 2020-21 (year 2021): bubble playoffs; R1 and QF single games, SF and F best-of-3.
2022-23 (year 2023): Shanghai and Jiangsu had 2022-23 results annulled for passive play in their R1 series (games kept here as played); Shenzhen advanced from QF by walkover.
Sina labels 2023-24..2025-26 rounds only as 季后赛; rounds assigned by chronological series order (4 R1, 4 QF, 2 SF, 1 F), matching zh.wikipedia brackets and asia-basket round labels.
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/<YYYY>年至<YYYY>年中国男子篮球职业联赛
https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/<YYYY>年CBA季后赛 and <YYYY>年CBA总决赛 (where they exist)
